name: Rangger
beschreibung: The Rangger in Sölden is a traditional inn in the Ötztal with a cozy atmosphere and regional cuisine. Its location near the ski slope makes it especially appealing to winter sports enthusiasts, but hikers and cyclists also find a central starting point here. The cozy interior with regional wood and alpine flair invites you to linger, while the terrace offers a view of the surrounding mountains. Breakfast and half board available, barrier-free rooms available.
